questions.question: The average of 6 numbers is 84. Their deviations from 80 total how much?
A group averages 36 years. When a 60-year-old joins, its average rises by 2 years. How many members were there originally?
2 groups average 48 and 78 marks, and together average 60. The lower-scoring group has 7 more members than the other. How many members are in the higher-scoring group?
questions.explanation: Counts are in ratio (78 − 60) : (60 − 48) = 3 : 2. 1 part is 7, so the higher-scoring group has 14 members.

questions.question: 3 schools send equal numbers of candidates. The combined averages for schools A and B, B and C, and C and A are 58, 64 and 67 marks respectively. Find the average for all candidates.
questions.explanation: Each school is counted twice across the 3 equal-sized pairs. Overall average = (58 + 64 + 67) ÷ 3 = 63.

questions.question: Find the average of all multiples of 9 from 100 to 200.
questions.explanation: The first and last terms are 108 and 198. Average = (108 + 198) ÷ 2 = 153.

questions.question: 5 years ago, 4 family members averaged 28 years. Twins were born 3 years ago. 1 original member died 2 years ago aged 58. Nobody else joined or left. Find the present average age of the 5 surviving members in years.
questions.explanation: Present equivalent total of the original 4 = 4 × (28 + 5) = 132. Remove 58 + 2 and add 3 + 3: average = (132 − 60 + 6) ÷ 5 = 15.6 years.

questions.question: A courier rides for 2 hours at 36 km/h and then for 3 hours at 54 km/h. Find the average speed in km/h.
A total of 1,764 forms were processed over several days, averaging 84 forms per day. How many days were used?
30 students average 52 kg. 3 students averaging 48 kg leave and 2 students join. The remaining 29 students average 54 kg. Find the total weight of the 2 newcomers in kg.
Each of 15 observations is increased by 12%. If their old average was 75, find the new average.
The average of 14 numbers is 63. Removing the greatest number reduces the average by 3. Find the removed number.
The first 6 of 10 readings average 42 and the last 6 average 47. All 10 average 44. Find the average of the 2 overlapping readings.
An average of 25 values is reported as 64 after 1 value is omitted from the total but the divisor remains 25. If the omitted value is 75, find the correct average.
7 consecutive integers average 104. Find the average of the smallest and greatest integers.
questions.explanation: For equally spaced integers, the endpoint average equals the whole-set average: 104.

questions.question: A batter’s average over 24 innings is 42 runs per innings. Excluding 1 innings of 88 runs and another innings, the average of the remaining 22 is 39. Find the other excluded score.
A train’s running speed is 72 km/h, but including halts its average speed is 60 km/h. How many minutes does it halt per hour of total journey time?
questions.explanation: In 1 hour, 60 km needs 60 ÷ 72 hours of running. Halt = (1 − 60 ÷ 72) × 60 = 10 minutes.

questions.question: The average of x, 2x + 3 and 3x − 3 is 26. Find x.
questions.explanation: Their total is 6x, so 6x ÷ 3 = 26 gives x = 13.

questions.question: A team of 22 averages 48 points. 3 new members score 60, 66 and 78 points. Find the new team average.
questions.explanation: Newcomers contribute 12 + 18 + 30 = 60 above the base. New average = 48 + 60 ÷ 25 = 50.4.

questions.question: A bowler concedes 117 runs at an average of 6.5 runs per over. How many legal balls has he bowled, taking 6 legal balls per over?
A family of 5 averages 30 years. A member aged 26 marries, and the spouse joins. After 2 years, all 6 average 32 years. Find the spouse’s age when joining, in years.
questions.explanation: Total at joining = 6 × (32 − 2) = 180. Spouse’s age = 180 − 5 × 30 = 30 years.

questions.question: A grocer buys 12 kg of rice at ₹48 per kg and 18 kg at ₹58 per kg. Find the average purchase price per kg in ₹.
2 equally large groups have average scores 55 and 71. Find their combined average score.
A test has 50 questions carrying 2 marks each, with no penalty for wrong answers. If a candidate’s average mark per question is 1.48, how many questions were answered correctly?

Find the 7th of 13 numbers. I: All 13 average 46 and the first 7 average 48. II: The last 7 average 45. Choose the code: 1 = I alone is sufficient; 2 = II alone is sufficient; 3 = both together are needed and sufficient; 4 = both together are insufficient.
questions.explanation: Neither statement alone isolates the 7th number. Together, it is 7 × 48 + 7 × 45 − 13 × 46 = 53, so both are needed and sufficient.

questions.question: A shop averages 140 customers per day over a 30-day month. The first 12 days average 125 customers. Find the daily average over the remaining days.
